gloss: feeling of inferiority; sense of inadequacy

definitions.gloss: feeling of inferiority; sense of inadequacy; self-consciousness
definitions.explanation: A feeling of being inferior to others or not measuring up. Often used with を感じる (to feel).

examples.japanese: {学歴|がくれき}に{引|ひ}け{目|め}を{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: I feel inferior about my educational background.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}も{引|ひ}け{目|め}に{感|かん}じることはない。
examples.english: There's nothing to feel inferior about.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りが{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{人|ひと}ばかりで、いつも{引|ひ}け{目|め}を{感|かん}じていた。
examples.english: Everyone around me was so talented that I always felt inadequate.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with を{感|かん}じる. Expresses a subjective feeling of being at a disadvantage or not being good enough compared to others. Not as strong as {劣等感|れっとうかん} (inferiority complex).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}を{感|かん}じる (to feel inferior)
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}がない (to have no sense of inadequacy)
- {引|ひ}け{目|め}を{取|と}らない (to be no less than, to hold one's own)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {劣等感|れっとうかん}: inferiority complex — stronger and more psychological
- {負|ま}い{目|め}: feeling of guilt, sense of obligation — involves moral responsibility rather than comparison
